title: Lead Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Venn

Venn is the fastest-growing B2B fintech in Canada.

We're on a mission to transform business banking for Canadian entrepreneurs and are looking to hire A-players interested in disrupting traditional banking practices. As the ONLY digital banking platform in Canada offering a truly modern solution, we have seen accelerated growth—scaling to support more than 15,000 Canadian businesses in under two years. Business owners are tired of the big banks’ monopoly and are looking for modern tools that replace the legacy systems that have been their only option for over 100 years.


We've raised over $26.5M from Tier 1 investors such as Gradient, Left Lane Capital, Intact, and XYZ Venture Capital. Interested in redefining the future of banking in Canada? Look no further.

What you’ll be doing

  • Collaborate with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Sales teams to support new product launches, feature rollouts, and recurring initiatives.

  • Bring campaigns to life through compelling web pages, bold visuals, GTM collateral, paid ads, and launch decks that capture attention and drive results.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Venn product experience, working closely with Product and Engineering on UI/UX design and flows.

  • Design intuitive and visually compelling interfaces that elevate core product experiences across web and mobile.

  • Maintain and expand the design system across both product and marketing surfaces to ensure visual consistency and scalability.

  • Partner with Growth and Marketing to design and optimize landing pages and campaign creative that drive measurable performance.

  • Create visuals and assets for events, social media, and content distribution when needed.

  • Balance product and marketing design work depending on priorities and timelines, moving fluidly between the two disciplines.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with a strong portfolio that includes both product design and marketing design work.

  • Proven ability to design landing pages, campaigns, and marketing assets that drive performance.

  • Strong product design skills including UI, UX, and interaction design for web and mobile.

  • Experience working on hybrid roles that span product and marketing design, with the ability to switch between them seamlessly.

  • Proficiency with modern design tools such as Figma, Webflow, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Experience maintaining and evolving a design system across multiple surfaces.

  • Comfortable working closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Sales teams.

  • Excellent communication skills, strong visual craft, and the ability to execute quickly without sacrificing quality.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-growing startup.

  • Experience at a fintech.


Perks & Benefits

  • Healthy equity ownership, among the most generous in the market, aligning your success with the company’s growth.

  • Comprehensive coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Opportunity to shape the future of business banking in Canada and beyond.

Venn is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, or disability.

This role is for an existing vacancy and we are looking to fill this role immediately.
